pangrams.text: Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow
pangrams.translation: Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow
pangrams.ipa: sfɪŋks əv blæk kwɔːts d͡ʒʌd͡ʒ maɪ vaʊ
pangrams.note: Shorter than the quick brown fox and still all 26 letters.

pangrams.text: Τάχιστη αλχημεία, ψιθυριστός κώδωνας, ξένος φόβος
pangrams.translation: Quick alchemy, whispered bell, foreign fear
pangrams.ipa: ˈtaxisti alçiˈmia psiθiriˈstos ˈkoðonas ˈksenos ˈfovos
pangrams.note: The better known Ξεσκεπάζω την ψυχοφθόρα βλακεία (“I uncover the soul-destroying stupidity”) is missing delta and gamma, so this one is used here instead.

pangrams.text: Съешь же ещё этих мягких французских булок, да выпей чаю.
pangrams.translation: Eat some more of these soft French buns, and drink some tea
pangrams.ipa: sjeʂ ʒɨ jɪˈɕːɵ ˈetʲɪx ˈmʲæxkʲɪx frɐnˈt͡suskʲɪx ˈbulək da ˈvɨpʲɪj ˈt͡ɕaju
pangrams.note: The standard Russian keyboard-test sentence, and the one that finally earns ъ and ь their place.

pangrams.text: דָּג מָהִיר וְקָפִיץ שִׁיר לְלֹא מִלִּים אָז גָּז וְנֶעֱלַם.
pangrams.translation: A fast, springy fish, a song without words, then vanished and disappeared
pangrams.ipa: daɡ maˈhiʁ veˈkafit͡s ʃiʁ leˈlo miˈlim az ɡaz veneʔeˈlam
pangrams.note: Written with the vowel points, which ordinary Hebrew leaves out — so typing this one means typing the niqqud too.

pangrams.text: صِفْ خَلْقَ خَوْدٍ كَمِثْلَةِ الشَّمْسِ إِذْ بَزَغَتْ يَحْظَى الضَّجِيعُ بِهَا نَجْلًا وَخَرْدَلَا
pangrams.translation: Describe the creation of a beautiful young woman, like the sun when it rises; whoever shares her bed obtains posterity and a grain of mustard seed
pangrams.ipa: sˤif xalqa xawdin kamiθlati ʃːamsi ʔið bazaɣat jaħˤˤaː dˤːad͡ʒiːʕu bihaː nad͡ʒlan waxardalaː
pangrams.note: Fully vocalised, so it exercises the harakat as well as the letters.

pangrams.text: «بر اثر چنین تلقین و شستشوی مغزی جامعی، سطح و پایهٔ ذهن و فهم و نظر بعضی اشخاص واژگونه و معکوس می‌شود.»
pangrams.translation: As a result of such thorough indoctrination and brainwashing, the level and foundation of the mind, understanding and viewpoint of some people becomes inverted and reversed
pangrams.ipa: bær ʔæsær t͡ʃeniːn tælɣiːn o ʃostoʃuːje mæɣziːje d͡ʒɒːmeːʔiː sætħ o pɒːjeje zehn o fæhm o næzˤære bæʔziː ʔæʃxɒːsː vɒːʒɡuːne o mæʔkuːs miːʃævæd
pangrams.note: It carries ژ and گ, the letters Persian adds to the Arabic alphabet.

pangrams.text: ऋषियों को सताने वाले दुष्ट राक्षसों के राजा रावण का सर्वनाश करने वाले विष्णुवतार भगवान श्रीराम, अयोध्या के महाराज दशरथ के बड़े सपुत्र थे।
pangrams.translation: Lord Rama, the avatar of Vishnu who destroyed Ravana — king of the wicked demons who tormented the sages — was the eldest son of King Dasharatha of Ayodhya
pangrams.ipa: ɾəʂijõ ko sətaːne ʌaːle dʊʂʈ raːkʂəsõ ke raːd͡ʒaː raːʌəɳ kaː sərʌənaːʃ kərne ʌaːle ʌiʂɳuʌtaːr bʱəɡʌaːn ʃriːraːm əjodʱjaː ke məhaːraːd͡ʒ dəʃərətʱ ke bəɾe səputɾ tʱe
pangrams.note: Covers the vowels and consonants of modern Hindi. The old Sanskrit pangram, कः खगौघाङ्चिच्छौजा, runs the consonants in alphabet order instead.

pangrams.text: นายสังฆภัณฑ์ เฮงพิทักษ์ฝั่ง ผู้เฒ่าซึ่งมีอาชีพเป็นฅนขายฃวด ถูกตำรวจปฏิบัติการจับฟ้องศาล ฐานลักนาฬิกาคุณหญิงฉัตรชฎา ฌานสมาธิ
pangrams.translation: Mr Sangkhaphan Hengphithakfang, an old man whose trade is selling bottles, was arrested by police and taken to court for stealing the watch of Khunying Chatchada Chansamathi
pangrams.ipa: naːj sǎŋ.kʰaː.pʰan heːŋ.pʰi.tʰak.faŋ pʰuː.tʰâw sɨ̂ŋ miː ʔaː.t͡ɕiːp pen kʰon kʰǎːj kʰùat tʰuːk tam.rúat pa.tì.bat.tiː.kan t͡ɕàp fɔ́ːŋ sǎːn tʰǎːn lak naː.liː.kaː kʰun.jǐŋ t͡ɕàt.t͡ɕa.daː t͡ɕaːn.sa.maː.tʰí
pangrams.note: Famous for reaching ฅ and ฃ, the two consonants Thai has retired — which is why it is longer and odder than most pangrams.

pangrams.text:
とりなくこゑす ゆめさませ
みよあけわたる ひんかしを
そらいろはえて おきつへに
ほふねむれゐぬ もやのうち
pangrams.translation: Birds are calling — wake from your dream! Look, the east is growing light. The sky takes on colour, and out on the open sea the boats crowd together in the morning mist.
pangrams.ipa:
to.ɾi na.kɯ ko.e sɯ jɯ.me sa.ma.se
mi.jo a.ke wa.ta.ɾɯ çiŋ.ɡa.ɕi o
so.ɾa i.ɾo ha.e.te o.ki tsɯ he ni
ho.ɸɯ.ne mɯ.ɾe i.nɯ mo.ja no ɯ.tɕi
pangrams.note: The Toriuta of 1903: 48 kana, each used exactly once. It includes ゐ and ゑ, which modern Japanese has dropped, and unlike the older Iroha poem it reaches ん as well.

pangrams.text: 키스의 고유 조건은 입술끼리 만나야 하고 특별한 요령은 필요치 않다
pangrams.translation: The essential condition for a kiss is that the lips must meet, and no special technique is required
pangrams.ipa: kʰi.sɯ.ɰi ko.ju t͡ɕo.ˀkʌ.nɯn ip̚.ˀsul.ˀki.ɾi man.na.ja ha.ɡo tʰɯk̚.ˀpjʌ.ɾan jo.ɾjʌŋ.ɯn pʰi.ɾjo.t͡ɕʰi an.tʰa
pangrams.note: The Korean typing-test sentence. The shorter 다람쥐 헌 쳃바퀴에 타고파 (“a squirrel wants to ride an old treadmill”) misses the harder clusters.

pangrams.text: የቀድሞው የኢፌዲሪ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶክተር ነጋሶ ጊዳዳ በተወለዱ በ76 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ።
pangrams.translation: The former president of Ethiopia, Dr Negaso Gidada, passed away at the age of 76
pangrams.ipa: jə.qʼəd.mow jə.ʔi.fe.di.ri pɨ.rez.dant dok.tər nə.ɡa.so ɡi.da.da bə.tə.wə.lə.du bə.sə.ba sɨ.dɨst ʕa.mə.ta.t͡ʃəw kə.zih ʕa.ləm bə.mot tə.lə.ju
pangrams.note: A news sentence rather than one written to order, which is why it reads plainly. The 76 is said ሰባ ስድስት, not spelled out.

pangrams.text: zuótiān wǒ bāng nǚ'ér qù yī jiā chāoshì mǎi kělè, xīfàn, dòupí, hǎizhé.
pangrams.translation: Yesterday I helped my daughter go to the supermarket to buy cola, congee, bean curd skin and jellyfish
pangrams.ipa: t͡swo˧˥.tʰjɛn˥˥ wo˨˩˧ paŋ˥˥ ny˨˩˧.ɕʱɚ˧˥ t͡ɕʰy˥˩ i˥˥ t͡ɕja˥˥ ʈ͡ʂʰau˥˥.ʂɹ̩˥˩ mai˨˩˧ kʰɤ˨˩˧.lɤ˥˩ ɕi˥˥.fan˥˩ tou˥˩.pʰi˧˥ xai˨˩˧.ʈ͡ʂɤ˧˥
pangrams.note: Written in pinyin with the tone marks, so it drills the diacritics as much as the letters.
